note: Flux-averaged, flux-summed-over-species (νμ+ν̄μ+νe+ν̄e, weighted by BNB flux composition; NC process cannot tag incident flavor) TOTAL (flux-integrated, non-differential) cross sections for NC single-π0 production on argon, MicroBooNE LArTPC (BNB beam, 5.89e20 POT). Three exclusive/semi-inclusive channels reported in Table "tab:summary_tab" (sec4_Cross_Sections.tex): (1) NCπ0 semi-inclusive (any proton multiplicity, efficiency-corrected for 2+p final states), (2) NCπ0+1p exclusive (exactly 1 proton, KE>50 MeV), (3) NCπ0+0p exclusive (exactly 0 protons). No kinematic differential variable — each is a single flux-integrated number, so lo=hi=0.8 GeV (the paper's quoted mean BNB neutrino energy ⟨Eν⟩=0.8 GeV, sec1_Intro.tex) following this project's convention for point/total measurements (matches e.g. microboone-2021gfj, sciboone-2010slc, minos-2016yyz which use lo=hi=mean energy). Target: per Ar (per argon atom/nucleus) — paper states units explicitly as "[1e-38 cm^2/Ar]" in Table tab:summary_tab and abstract (main.tex line ~291); N_targets computed as number of Ar atoms in fiducial volume, confirming per-nucleus (not per-nucleon) normalization..
